gen-titan-one-fs-supreme: Brush-soft curve ends that stop short, on letters of uniform stroke, give Titan One its bouncy, towering personality up top. Supreme answers with sturdy, open sans-serif text.
gen-titan-one-general-sans: Titan One crowds the line with towering, fixed-width letters whose curves end like lifted brush strokes, while General Sans fills its line with smooth, steady sans. Loud and tidy, in one go.
gen-titan-one-manrope: Chunky, cheerful, a bit cartoonish: Titan One stamps tall letters of uniform stroke, with curves that stop like lifted brushes. Manrope's bright, open sans-serif curves keep a long read light and approachable.
gen-titan-one-satoshi: Fat, bouncy letters with brushy curve ends make Titan One the loud one here, standing tall without any thinning. And Satoshi's soaring x-height and open e give that noise a sans-serif partner that looks relaxed beside it.
gen-titan-one-work-sans: Work Sans keeps its c tips well apart and its mean line high, a modern sans-serif that lets Titan One's brushy, uniform-stroke heading do the shouting. Playful on top, composed below.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-saira: Saira reads crisply, with see-through s shapes and rounded letters reaching high toward the top line. And Revalia's wide-striding, open-g display letters above it keep a longer page feeling relaxed.
gen-tourney-noto-serif: Noto Serif brings a literary, subtly modulated stroke and a prominent x-height, like soft metal stamped with the letters. And Tourney's wide-tracked, constant-width neon tubing sits against it like a stadium sign over a bookshelf.
gen-unifrakturmaguntia-archivo: Tight, clustered words with lofty lowercase give UnifrakturMaguntia a gothic, commanding look that is hard to ignore. Yet Archivo's outward-opening sans-serif curves and tall x-height keep the page approachable and editorial.
gen-unifrakturmaguntia-fs-asap: Asap is a plain sans with open arcs for its c and a body height nearly level with the capitals, so it reads clearly. Asap can stay modest in size, since UnifrakturMaguntia's gothic heading carries the drama.
gen-unifrakturmaguntia-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Gothic and tightly clustered, UnifrakturMaguntia looms over the page like carved oak. But Be Vietnam Pro's rod-straight strokes and high mean line make a clean sans that gives the eye somewhere to rest.
